surface: 3 unordered context pairs x 2 directions x 3 metrics = 18 directed surfaces

canonical_summary.same_context_d_adj_source: matched A/B pseudo-context U-corrected pair-state estimates from the risk grid

estimator_unit_audit.purpose: diagnose finite-measurement D_adj null dependence on estimator unit; not a primary-result replacement
estimator_unit_audit.current_unit: flatten 15 seeds x 2 measurement replicates per pseudo-context, then one U-corrected estimate
estimator_unit_audit.alternative_unit: U-correct each aligned two-replicate seed block, then average 15 seed-level estimates
estimator_unit_audit.seed_pairing: same sorted index between partition A and partition B; deterministic and non-overlapping
estimator_unit_audit.interpretation: signed finite-sample null estimates remain diagnostic; no clipping or result selection is applied

matched_unit_audit.purpose: compare the primary flattened partition with one common aligned seed-block construction for every comparator
matched_unit_audit.unit: 15 aligned seed blocks; each block retains its two measurement replicates
matched_unit_audit.rank_comparator_unit: collapse the two replicates within each seed block, then compare the 15 block-level mean vectors
matched_unit_audit.d_adj_unit: U-correct each aligned two-replicate block, then average the 15 block-level estimates
matched_unit_audit.stable_unit: evaluate the frozen stable rule on the 15 block-level vectors; support threshold remains >=8

protocol.partition_policy: sorted 30 split seeds into disjoint A=first 15 and B=last 15; both measurement replicates remain within each seed block

estimands.kendall_distance: (1-tau-b)/2 between mean risk vectors of independent pseudo-context blocks
estimands.spearman_distance: (1-rho)/2 between mean risk vectors of independent pseudo-context blocks
estimands.top10_jaccard_distance: 1-Jaccard of deterministic lower-risk top-10% sets; item-index tie break
estimands.stable_pair_inversion_fraction: held-out inversion among pairs selected stable in both pseudo-contexts; 7/8 seed cross-fit, minimum strict support >=8
estimands.d_adj: U-corrected pair-state divergence between independent pseudo-context replicate arrays; finite negative estimates are retained
estimands.normalized_recovery: signed macro margin divided by the absolute full-depth macro margin for the same comparator; no clipping
estimands.normalized_signal_fraction: signed macro margin divided by the absolute macro cross estimate
estimands.evaluable_coverage: 1 for full-vector comparators; for stable inversion, mean held-out non-tie evaluable pair fraction

bootstrap.macro_interval: percentile interval over unordered context-pair blocks applied to the fixed matched-partition surface estimates
bootstrap.surface_interval: percentile interval over the two independent A/B cross orientations and two same-context terms
bootstrap.lower_ci_fraction: fraction of finite surface-level partition-bootstrap lower bounds above zero
